title: Prepare core for the GEMI pillar to leave: route its direct callers over the bus
goal: Vision: V-9. Core half of relocating susi-gemi and susi-gemi-models (about 35,000 runtime lines) to susi-commercial-apps (commercial T-CORESIZEVAULT-22; decisions 2470, 2506). (1) Route the daemon's and CLI's direct susi_gemi calls (susi-daemon provider_ops.rs, discovery_pipeline.rs, host_views.rs, runtime_admin.rs, estate_loop.rs; src/cli os_cli.rs, keys_cli.rs, mission_cli.rs) through gemi.* plane topics, so the only link left is composition.rs registering the gemi. prefix. (2) Let scoped gemi.* requests leave the process (plane_bus.rs req keeps gemi.* in-process under a ToolScope; GEMI returns tool_calls to its caller, board 2588). (3) After commercial's copy serves gemi.* with side-by-side parity on Windows and Linux, stop linking susi-gemi and susi-gemi-models, delete them and lower COMPLETE_SOCKET_CEILING.

reuse.searched: The gemi. prefix handler core already registers (susi-gemi plane_handler.rs) and the plane_bus GemiEngine facade, which already speak gemi.* topics; the plug host's existing GEMI topics.

limitations: Pillar code: Linux pass (SusiCoreSizeVault, board 2549) before the deletion. Coordinate with grok (T-GROKCORESIZE-1, daemon handlers) on the daemon files.
